# t28.2 — Add a safe keep-alive workflow

## Summary

Added `.github/workflows/keepalive.yml` to check API readiness every 10 minutes and daily, then
check the protected database-size endpoint once daily. The DB-size check validates the expected
response contract and fails above 80% of 500 MiB. The workflow has no repository write
permissions, never prints the internal token, and supports manual dispatch. Updated `docs/PLAN.md`
to describe the workflow and distinguish local configuration from unverified production operation.

The workflow is locally checked, not live-tested. Production checklist items remain unchecked.

## Workflow Behavior

- `/readyz` is requested on the 10-minute schedule and the daily schedule. Only HTTPS API URLs
  are accepted; missing or invalid values fail clearly.
- `/internal/db-size` runs daily at 03:17 UTC and on `workflow_dispatch`. The request uses
  `Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN`; the token is provided only through the Actions secret
  environment and is not echoed.
- The response must contain non-negative numeric `bytes` and `percent` fields and the expected
  `limit_bytes` value of 524,288,000. Usage greater than 80% fails the job.
- Workflow permissions are empty (no `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions are granted). Both jobs have a
  bounded timeout and curl connection/total timeouts.
- Job failure is visible in Actions; email and other notification delivery depends on repository
  and user settings.
